blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (Path traversal in read_attachment bypasses the ticket authorization check) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: CWE-22. The `name` the client asks for is joined to the ticket directory as is. An agent authorized on their own ticket 1 sends name `../7/contract.pdf` and reads an attachment of ticket 7, owned by another team, so the `may_read_ticket` check is bypassed; `../../../../../etc/passwd` or an absolute name such as `/etc/shadow` (which makes `os.path.join` discard the base) reads any file the service can read. Validate `name` where it enters: reject anything that is not equal to `os.path.basename(name)`, empty, `.` or `..`; better, look the name up in the `attachments` table for this `ticket_id` and only open names recorded there. As defence in depth, resolve the final path with `os.path.realpath` and check it stays under `os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, str(ticket_id))`. Add a test that requests `../<other ticket>/<file>` and an absolute path and expects a refusal.
findings.title: Path traversal in read_attachment bypasses the ticket authorization check

findings.evidence:
def save_attachment(ticket_id: int, filename: str, data: bytes) -> str:
    """Stores an uploaded file under the ticket's directory; returns its name."""
    name = os.path.basename(filename)
    directory = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, str(ticket_id))
findings.recommendation: CWE-862. Unlike `read_attachment`, the upload takes no `agent_id` and never calls `may_read_ticket`, so any authenticated agent can attach files to (and, with the same name, overwrite the stored file of) a ticket owned by another team, unless a caller not part of this change checks it. Take the agent id and enforce the same ownership check on the server before writing. Confidence is low because the HTTP handler calling this function is not in the diff.
findings.title: save_attachment enforces no authorization on the target ticket
